name: Creation
description:
Casting Time: 1 minute. Concentration, up to 1 day.

You pull arcane energy out of the weave and shape it into a temporary, nonliving object of organic matter (wood, cloth, etc.) in a space within short range. The object must be of a form and material you have seen before and can be no larger than 5 ft in any dimension.

Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe what you create.
successes:
✨: The object may be made of stone.

✨: Up to half of the object may be made of metal.

🌞: The whole object may be made of any combination of materials you have seen.

💀: You lose control of the energy you're gathering together and the object explodes. Roll Lore vs Dexterity against all creatures within short range. On a win, they take 2d6 damage and check a condition. You also check a condition.

improvements.name: Greater Creation
improvements.description: The size limit for your creation increases to 10 ft in any dimension.
